banned.claim: Unqualified 'eco-friendly' or 'sustainable' as a standalone headline claim without substantiation.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - vague/unqualified environmental claims must be specific and backed; 'natural/clean/eco' are risky as bare headlines.
FTC Green Guides - absolute environmental claims are almost never substantiable and are high-risk.

banned.claim: 'World's clearest vision' stated as an unqualified superiority fact in ads.
banned.why: Comparative superiority claim - not substantiated with test data in the input; run only as brand tagline, not a performance guarantee.

banned.claim: 'Fully biodegradable' or 'compostable' framing for Zirtek/3D-printed frames.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - degradability claims require competent scientific evidence not present on the site.

banned.claim: Any claim that the eyewear prevents eye disease or protects/cures vision health.
banned.why: Health/disease-treatment claims are banned for this category without qualified medical substantiation.
Site states US patents pending, not granted - claiming a patent is issued would be false advertising.
